skill.name: gsd:insert-phase
skill.description: Insert a phase into the roadmap
skill.body:
# GSD Insert Phase

Inserts a phase into the roadmap at specific position.

## When to Use

- Adding phase at specific position
- Reordering roadmap

## Process

1. Identify insertion point
2. Create phase
3. Update roadmap

## Success Criteria

Phase inserted into roadmap.

generated_query: I have a product roadmap with the following phases in order: Discovery, Design, Development, QA, and Launch. I need to insert a new "User Testing" phase right between Design and Development. The roadmap is stored as a numbered list in our project management tool. Please adjust the phase order so that "User Testing" comes third, shifting Development to fourth and QA to fifth, with Launch remaining last. After the change, the roadmap should be: Discovery, Design, User Testing, Development, QA, Launch.

edit_instructions.rationale: Without creating the phase, the roadmap update would be invalid.
